fusions.name: Marking Stone
fusions.desc: Flings a stone that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 50% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds. Its damage rises +8% per ally within 5 tiles (max +32%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Closing Snatch
fusions.desc: A snatching blow that deals 16 damage, draws out every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one. It leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Ring the Prey
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 12 seconds. A troop escort hunts beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent Trail
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
